race.comment: DON'TCHA LUV'ER (6) just missed the bob first-up at the Sunny Coast before taking another strong account of herself last time at Eagle Farm. Peaking now and keeps Thompson from the gun draw. Ready. NO FOOLING (2) also resumes and makes his stable debut for the Gollan camp. Showed plenty of promise in Victoria and is a noted fresh performer. Two lead-up trials have him ready to fire. Can make a bright start in the new colours. SHREDDED (3) returns and has run well fresh without winning. Has been fitted with two trial wins and gets in light with the 3kg claimer reuniting. Bold showing anticipated. His stablemate ANOTHER CASHIE (4) is also first up. Tackled much stronger races last campaign, so will appreciate the easier assignment here. Two trials have him ready to run well.
